en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a wooden café or restaurant dining room. The room has wood‑panelled walls and ceiling, large multi‑pane windows with sheer curtains, and polished wooden floors. Square tables with tablecloths are neatly arranged, each with simple wooden chairs and small flower vases as centerpieces. Hanging plants and wreaths decorate the space, along with framed pictures on the walls and a wooden sideboard or cabinet at the back. Ceiling light fixtures with round bulbs hang from above. No people are present.
